title: Apophthegmata Patrum (Sayings of the Desert Fathers, Sahidic Coptic via Coptic SCRIPTORIUM)
attribution: Coptic SCRIPTORIUM (Caroline T. Schroeder, Amir Zeldes, Elizabeth Davidson, Christine Luckritz Marquis, Elizabeth Platte, Nicholas Wagner, et al.). Licensed CC BY 4.0.
notes: 126 gold-annotated Sahidic Coptic sayings (AP/apophthegmata.patrum_TT/*.tt) with English translations from CopticScriptorium/corpora tag v6.2.0 (commit 6c2acf0ebebf62f40c3834259cf6fd734238e371) used for non-biblical Coptic span-denoising pretraining and cop->eng multi-task pivot training in model-v3.
